newsitem.title: USA: PaineWebber hires two for Los Angeles muni office.
newsitem.headline: PaineWebber hires two for Los Angeles muni office.

text.p: PaineWebber Inc, a unit of PaineWebber Group Inc, said it has hired Anthony Fisher as a managing director and Jeffrey Bower as a vice president in its Municipal Securities Group's Los Angeles, Calif., office.
Fisher and Bower are former executives in Merrill Lynch & Co's municipal markets division.
Fisher will manage the Group's California general market effort, focusing on large cities, counties and states, including public power and water-sewer issuers.
He will work with James Ziglar, a managing director and member of the Municipal Securities Group Executive Committee.

Bower will provide coverage to general governmental and utility clients, working with Fisher and Frank Lauterbur, who joined PaineWebber in 1996, as well as other Group professionals in Los Angeles and San Francisco.
Before joining PaineWebber, Fisher was with Merrill Lynch for 15 years, where he was a managing director of public finance, and the firm's senior municipal utility banker.

Before joining PaineWebber, Bower was a vice president in the municipal finance group at Merrill Lynch, which he joined in 1988. Bower also previously worked as a member of the finance staff of the Orange County Water District.
PaineWebber's 275-member Municipal Securities Group structures, underwrites, distributes and trades taxable and tax-exempt debt securities issued by U.S. municipalities and public agencies.
